item.text: I found the mismatch. The RGB transform was right, but the saturation formula has to follow the original branch form `l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min)` instead of the algebraically simplified version; outside the usual `[0,1]` range those are not equivalent. I’m patching that and aligning the operation order with the binary.
